content.text: {"core": "Tune fixes things by small adjustments — nudge, taste, nudge again — until something settles. Seated in its own position, what gets adjusted is the adjusting itself: the reach for the next tweak. Overdone, the reaching never stops. Every settled thing gets reopened for one more pass, and the correcting outlasts anything worth correcting.", "sheetLine": "The last small fix arrives, then the hand reaches for another that isn't needed."}
